mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as measured by the FEDFUNDS series.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market overheating that triggers imminent Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST) and employment growth (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer spending, driving multiplicative positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through enhanced corporate revenue visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and PAYEMS exceed their 90th percentiles, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers aggressive Federal Reserve tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO has increased over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1,100 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand and potential economic slowdown, increasing equity risk and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where HOUST falls below 1100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates monetary tightening during labor market strength, amplifying recession risk and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through multiplicative effect.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with strong labor market
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP level exceeding 18,500 billion dollars (GDPC1 > 18500) indicates robust economic expansion phase that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 exceeds 18500, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
